## What do you want?

Describe what you want in plain language. Don't worry about technical
details — that's the pipeline's job to figure out.

## Why?

What problem does this solve, or what's the goal?

## Anything specific you already know?

Constraints, deadlines, systems it needs to work with, examples of what
"done" looks like — anything that will save the Business Analyst a
round trip.
